_about: Synthetic recording made by `make fixtures-synth` from fixtures/demo_world.json in the documented response shape; replace with `make fixtures` once a tenant exists.

variables.input:
fetch spans, from: -1h
| filter service.name == "inventory"
| fieldsSummary db.statement, db.operation.name
| fields field

1.title: Slowest statements
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "inventory" and span.name == "SELECT inventory.stock"
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{$Attribute:backtick}
| sort p95 desc
| limit 20
